title: CloudTrail Evasion Chain
description: An attacker with CloudTrail and S3 permissions performs multiple actions to reduce audit visibility. They use cloudtrail:UpdateTrail to change the trail configuration (e.g., disable logging or point to a different bucket). They use cloudtrail:PutEventSelectors to exclude data events or management events from being logged. They use s3:PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration on the CloudTrail bucket to add a lifecycle rule that deletes or transitions objects quickly, reducing the retention of existing logs. This chain degrades or eliminates audit trail coverage.

steps.context: Modify event selectors to exclude events
Modify bucket lifecycle to delete logs
